prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one elegant, extremely simple Retty symbol image inspired by the attached reference. The reference is visual inspiration for its restrained dark palette, circular silhouette, soft ivory terminal strokes, quiet depth and generous negative space; make a new, clean design.
Product idea: Retty is a native terminal workbench. A terminal session continues while the user switches between Mac, iPhone and a server. Express terminal input and continuous connection using very few strong shapes.
Canvas: one square 1536 × 1536 image. Uniform almost-black background #0D0E10. One centered dark graphite circular disc, about 74% of the canvas width, with a very restrained soft tonal variation like the reference.
Symbol: inside the disc, one large off-white #EEECE3 terminal prompt, constructed from a softly rounded thick greater-than chevron on the left and a short broad underscore below and to its right. To the upper right of the prompt, replace the reference's star with ONE compact continuous-connection symbol: two simple interlocking rounded oval loops, horizontally joined, with the same off-white stroke weight as the prompt. The loops should read as a single rounded chain-link or infinity connection glyph. Keep this connection glyph subordinate to the terminal prompt but large enough to recognize at small sizes. Give the three components clear spacing and form one balanced compact group.
Style: precise, minimal, polished graphic geometry, thick strokes with fully rounded ends, clean edges, softly rounded joins. Match the reference's calm understated feeling. No character, no face, no lettering, no asterisk, no extra decorations, no device drawings, no fine lines, no mockup, no frames or shadows outside the disc, no glossy material, no dramatic 3D or textures. Show one finished symbol only.
